description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useBeamSimulation' that performs beam tracing computations for a light puzzle game. It optimizes rendering by batching beam calculations per animation frame and exposes a stable array reference of segments. It also manages target lighting state updates.

methods.name: useBeamSimulation({ grid, lasers, rows, cols, targets, onTargetsUpdate })
methods.description: A React hook that calculates beam segments for a grid-based game, batching computations per animation frame and updating target states.
